title: [YSQL] Attaching a partitioned index fails
body:
Jira Link: [DB-3913](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-3913)
### Description

```
-- Create partitioned table and index
create table idxpart (a int, b int) partition by range (a, b);
create index idxpart_a_b_idx on only idxpart (a, b);

-- Create partitioned table and index
create table idxpart1 partition of idxpart for values from (0, 0) to (10, 10);
create index idxpart1_a_b_idx on idxpart1 (a, b);

-- Attach index partition
yugabyte=# alter index idxpart_a_b_idx attach partition idxpart_a_b_idx;
ERROR:  "idxpart_a_b_idx" is an index
    @        0x109c6eb93  errmsg
    @        0x10954d8d1  heap_openrv
    @        0x1097ff105  YBCPrepareAlterTableCmd
    @        0x1097fe679  YBCPrepareAlterTable
    @        0x1097a0f86  ATRewriteCatalogs
    @        0x10979a2a4  ATController
    @        0x10979a1a9  AlterTable
    @        0x109a8e6b4  ProcessUtilitySlow
    @        0x109a8c5bb  standard_ProcessUtility
    @        0x109a8aed2  YBProcessUtilityDefaultHook
    @        0x10b4828ff  pgss_ProcessUtility
    @        0x10b46813f  ybpgm_ProcessUtility
    @        0x10dd2cc19  pgaudit_NextProcessUtility_hook
    @        0x10dd2b8d7  pgaudit_ProcessUtility_hook
    @        0x10e2bc3e9  pg_hint_plan_ProcessUtility
    @        0x109cb403f  YBTxnDdlProcessUtility
    @        0x109a8b3f8  ProcessUtility
    @        0x109a8aa8e  PortalRunUtility
    @        0x109a89c6b  PortalRunMulti
    @        0x109a8916c  PortalRun
    @        0x109a86703  exec_simple_query
    @        0x109a84b55  yb_exec_simple_query_impl
    @        0x109a84c8c  yb_exec_query_wrapper_one_attempt
    @        0x109a84b2a  yb_exec_query_wrapper
    @        0x109a80915  yb_exec_simple_query
    @        0x109a7f733  PostgresMain
    @        0x1099afd99  BackendRun
    @        0x1099aef77  BackendStartup
    @        0x1099adabc  ServerLoop
    @        0x1099aab3e  PostmasterMain
    @        0x1098abedb  PostgresServerProcessMain
    @        0x1098ac302  main
```

In `YBCPrepareAlterTableCmd`, we try to determine the relations for which schema version needs to be incremented due to this alter. Under the case `AT_AttachPartition`, we only consider the case where we attach a partition table - and try to call `heap_openrv` on the entity being attached. This fails because `heap_openrv` is not meant to be called on an index.

Regression introduced by commit: 76a39035a8c3aa3a4f0bd63f2aa43fe236135170
